asks: Where should Outcomes Accelerator funds go first?
Model funding options for the Outcomes Accelerator
st_funds.ai: I modeled three options, and I would fund A and C together and run B as a no-cost data service.
points: A: care coordinators and telehealth rechecks in Lander and Pershing; avoidable ED down about 12% within a year.
B: shared low-value care feedback across all four networks; cuts about a third of the $2.4M.
C: mobile clinic days for the six low-broadband ZIP codes.
